name: Graciela Ortiz
office: City of Huntington Park, Member of the City Council, 4th District

items.text: Graciela Ortiz formerly served on the Huntington Park City Council. She served two terms as mayor. She is a pupil services and attendance administrator for L.A. Unified. After she was elected in 2015, she voted for a bus contract with a firm connected to her campaign; costs rose, but she said the state's Fair Political Practices Commission advised her the vote was legal. In 2024, she was put on administrative leave from her L.A. Unified post while the district investigated; she was later reinstated. In 2025, search warrants were executed at her home as part of a corruption investigation into a failed pool complex. She has not been charged.
